shape_trans — 2D region op

• Data kinds: region → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "shape_trans", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: shape_trans (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

領域の凸包(`skimage.morphology.convex_hull_image`)を返す。HALCON の

`shape_trans`（Transform the shape of a region.）は本来 convex/

rectangle1/ellipse など複数の変形モードを `Type` 引数で選べる演算子

だが、この代役では凸包 1 種類に固定している(近似の限界)。

`a, b` は未使用。skimage が無い環境ではこの分岐は呼べない。
